Adobe's trained upscaling model. Substitute: an open-source super-resolution model the user downloads (e.g. an ESRGAN-family ONNX model), clearly labelled as such

Absent; Photoshop uses a proprietary object-detection model. Substitute: an open-source segmentation model the user downloads (e.g. Segment Anything ONNX) creating one masked group per object, or Pigment's heuristic Object Selection run per region, labelled as approximate

View of RGB pixels with derived L/a/b channels; adjustments and filters still run on RGB, so Lab-specific workflows (curves on a/b, sharpening L) are not possible
modes.js image:trap + modes/dialogs.js trapDialog (width in px/pt/mm), enabled in CMYK mode; works on the derived CMYK view of RGB pixels, not real plates
